notes: STRONGEST NEW FINDING IN FIELD X. This is a GENUINE second cohort, not an application round: UNIE publishes a SEPARATE, title-specific academic calendar for the April convocatoria, with its own 'Inicio docencia por semestre' and its own complementos-formativos start — a deadline-round would not get its own teaching calendar. The exact 'inicio docencia' day is colour-coded in the PDF grid and could not be read as text; the calendar window is March 2026 – February 2027, so complementos start in March and teaching in April. A human should open the PDF to read the highlighted day. UNIE uses the same two-calendar pattern across its másteres universitarios (e.g. Formación del Profesorado publishes '...Conv.Octubre.pdf' and '..._Abril.pdf'), so the April convocatoria is an institution-wide structure, not a one-off. Note the aggregator educaweb said 'próximas convocatorias abril y octubre' and was, unusually, RIGHT — but it is the university's own April calendar PDF that establishes it. Presencial + Spanish are the two filters for this candidate.
